summary: MUFG filed a 6-K reporting a board-approved open-market share repurchase program under Japan's Companies Act. The buyback covers up to 45 million shares (0.40% of outstanding) for up to ¥100 billion during May 18–June 30, 2026. No price per share or premium is stated; purchases will occur on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The move aims to improve shareholder returns and capital efficiency, balancing equity capital with growth investments. This is a routine capital return, not a tender offer. Watch execution pace and any impact on capital ratios.
